result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major missing-element problem where a restaurant card image is broken.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image fails to load and shows a light gray placeholder box with a centered broken-image icon instead of a restaurant/food photo, unlike the other restaurant cards which display images.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/asset for Tokumaru Ramen Bar, verify the CDN source, and add a proper fallback image and loading/error handling so a broken-image placeholder is never shown.
